subject: Glimmer login troubles if you ever mis-capitalise username in firefox.

messages.author: c8fe4075ec631c03
messages.subject: Glimmer login troubles if you ever mis-capitalise username in firefox.
parts:
Hi,

  I have been using glimmer on various computers, and on one I typed my username with capitalisation different from the real one.

  Once you do this, firefox never lets go of the original capitalisation, and with patronisingly replace it for you with your first (wrong) form.

  Would you consider making usernames non case sensitive in glimmer to avoid this frustrating issue?

-Alex
